name: Safety First
summary: On the Shimmering Flats, you carry Shreev’s modified seaforium booster back to Razzeric. Shreev warns that one slip while setting it off could leave Razzeric a scorch mark on the track.

sections.title: A Warning from Shreev
sections.body: Shreev hands you the modified booster, prepared as Razzeric asked. He warns that Razzeric must take care when setting it off. One slip, and Razzeric will be a scorch mark on the track instead of racing ahead. Shreev says that would be a shame. Then he wonders whether the nineteenth driver would have been any good.

sections.title: Sand Under the Seat
sections.body: Back on the Shimmering Flats, Razzeric grumbles that Pozzik loaded a bucket of sand onto his racer. How can he reach top speed with sand beneath the seat?

sections.title: The Booster Returned
sections.body: Razzeric is pleased with the modified booster. He wishes he could see the gnomes’ faces when he sets it off. Yet he expects to be too busy setting a new course record.

faq.q: Who sends the modified booster back to the flats?
faq.answer: In Gadgetzan, Shreev finishes modifying the seaforium booster as Razzeric wanted. Then he gives it to you to carry back to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats.
Shreev warns Razzeric to take care when setting off the booster. One slip, and Razzeric will be a scorch mark on the track instead of racing ahead.

faq.q: Why is Razzeric upset about his vehicle?
faq.answer: Pozzik loaded a bucket of sand onto Razzeric’s racer. Razzeric wonders how he can reach top speed with sand beneath the seat.
